name: Imphal
registryBasis: The Government of Manipur Revenue Department describes the state land-record system, its village/urban-ward record units, and field maps, while the Government of Manipur publishes an Imphal Municipality cadastral map and explicitly directs users to the Directorate of Settlement & Land Record for the official office map. This supports local land-record administration; the published municipal map is planning-only and does not establish open parcel geometry or complete registry coverage at the WUP point.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.

officialSources.observation: Manipur Revenue Department land-record system describes field maps, Dag Chitha/Jamabandi records and settled village records.
The official preparation page describes records at village level and, in towns, more or less at ward level.
Government of Manipur Imphal Municipality cadastral PDF is explicitly marked for planning only and says office cadastral maps should be obtained from the Directorate of Settlement & Land Record.
The official Land Resources Department about page places the department in Imphal and describes GIS/survey/record responsibilities; it does not publish city parcel vectors.
